sentences.text: Nick Jonas is the second eponymous studio album by American singer-songwriter Nick Jonas .	Nick Jonas	Nick Jonas	eponymous	eponymous	studio album	studio album	singer-songwriter	singer-songwriter
It was released on November 10 , 2014 , by Island Records .	Island	Island Records	Island Records	Island Records
The album features a sole collaborations with Angel Haze , Demi Lovato and Mike Posner .	Angel Haze	Angel Haze	Demi Lovato	Demi Lovato	Mike Posner	Mike Posner
